title: tri-cloud-partner-sync-rapid-notes-amanda
content:
Purpose:
Rapid prep notes for tri-cloud marketplace sync (AWS / Azure / GCP). Personal scratchpad — distill talking points, list open blockers, quick asks, and immediate follow-ups I want to drive after the call.

Attendees (planned):
- AWS Partner AM: Diego Ramos (confirm)
- Azure Marketplace PM: Priya Singh
- GCP Channel Lead: Lina Patel
- Me: Amanda Chen (owner, marketplace GTM)
- Optional: Legal AP/Contracts (TBD)

Topline goals for sync:
- Confirm status of listing technical integration for each cloud (metering, private offers, entitlements).
- Align on go-live gating items and who owns them.
- Price import / SKU mapping cadence (who feeds pricing updates).
- Clarify recurring billing path and reporting cadence (monthly consolidated vs per-customer).
- Agree on pilot customers + timeline for Featured listing requests.

Agenda (10–15m chunks; keep tight):
1) Quick status round-robin (1–2 mins each) — current blocking items
2) Technical: metering API, licensing entitlements, webhook reliability (3–4 mins per cloud)
3) Commercial: marketplace fees, private-offer flow, invoice/reconciliation model (5 mins)
4) Launch ops: banner / co-marketing checklist, required assets, timeline (3 mins)
5) Decisions & owners + immediate next steps (final 5 mins)

Notes / talking pts (by cloud)
AWS:
- Metering: need sample metering payload and test account from Diego. Our runtime needs to emit usage with product_code X and dimension 'inference_tokens' — verify dimension naming with AWS partner ops.
- Private offers: legal wants template; verify if AWSPM requires CLIN in PO.
- Action: ask Diego for partner-account id + sandbox metering creds by EOD + link to docs.

Azure:
- Marketplace listings expect ARM template + container image. Confirm whether Redwood Dedicated qualifies under Azure App Offer vs Managed Service.
- Licensing: Azure requires license file upload for BYOL flows — check if our onboarding scripts can generate this.
- Action: Priya to share sample ARM + list of required assets; I will confirm runtime packaging steps.

GCP:
- Billing: GCP subscriptions vs Marketplace SaaS metering — decide which to use for first pilot (recommend SaaS metering for per-token).
- Entitlements: GCP has different license model; need mapping doc from Lina.
- Action: request Lina to share a short mapping doc + example pubsub event for usage.

Cross-cloud technical blockers (common):
- Token-level metering schema — we must standardize: timestamp, model_id, tokens_generated, customer_id, request_id. Create spec doc and share.
- Retry semantics on webhooks: they currently drop duplicates — require idempotency keys.
- Integration test harness: we need a minimal end-to-end smoke test for each cloud (list -> enable -> simulate usage -> verify billing event).

Commercial / legal notes:
- Marketplace fee model: propose starting with list price net of marketplace fee; finance wants monthly consolidated reconciliation feed (CSV) — ask partners if they can provide automated reports.
- Revenue recognition: flag for finance — ensure private-offer invoicing path doesn't double-count credits.
- Marketing: request co-marketing slots (1 blog + 1 webinar) as part of pilot; ask for feature placement policies.

Open questions to surface in meeting:
- Which partner is responsible for customer entitlement enforcement vs our runtime?
- Are there limits on webhook throughput per listing? (we will likely exceed default)
- SLA expectations for metering latency (important for near-real-time billing).
- Any regional restrictions for private offers (EU-specific procurement rules)?

Decisions I want to make by EOD + why:
- Agree on 1 metering schema across clouds — reduces ops burden.
- Assign owners for test accounts and smoke tests (deadline 2 weeks).
- Lock launch checklist (assets + legal) and identify missing pieces.

Immediate follow-ups / action items (scratch list)
- Amanda: draft metering schema spec + example payloads (due 2024-11-22) [IN_PROGRESS]
- Diego: provide AWS sandbox metering creds + partner-account ID (due 2024-11-20) [TODO]
- Priya: share ARM template example + required asset list (due 2024-11-21) [TODO]
- Lina: gcp mapping doc + example pubsub usage event (due 2024-11-21) [TODO]
- Eng (integrations): stand up smoke test repo + CI job (assignee TBA; target 2w) [BLOCKED: need test creds]
- Legal: send private-offer template; identify clauses we must push back on (Amanda to ping) (due 2024-11-25)

Notes to self (voice memo paraphrase):
- Keep the meeting tight — 30 mins max. Start with 1 sentence on pilot parameters, then unblockers.
- If debate on fee splits stalls, table it and move to finance-only thread. We need technical integration first.
- Bring up co-marketing ask early (marketing calendar fills fast).

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy):
Subject: Tri-cloud marketplace sync — actions & owners (MM/DD)
Hi all, thanks for the sync. Recap: 
- Quick bullets of decisions
- Action owners (copy from this doc)
- Next sync date proposed: two weeks
Attach: metering schema draft + minimal test plan + links to required assets (ask for credentials in-thread).

Loose ideas / stretch goals (brainstorm):
- Offer a small free-tier token allotment via marketplaces for new customers (marketing hook).
- Auto-rollout small sample of customers across clouds to compare metering accuracy and latency.

Backburner (not for this call):
- Deep dive on GA roadmap for Dedicated via marketplaces.
- Explore partner referral fees and co-sell program integration.

Version notes: initial scratchpad created 2024-11-15; updated with extra asks and action owners 2024-11-28.

---
Personal quick checklist before hitting join:
- Attach the metering spec draft to the calendar invite.
- Confirm Diego/Priya/Lina availability (ping Slack).
- Put legal contact on the thread.

End of scratchpad.
